issues.description: The template PersonService class defines an additional public method validatePerson(Person) that is not present in the solution repository and is not mentioned in the problem statement. This extra method is an unexpected structural difference between template and solution and may confuse students who compare their work to the reference solution or wonder whether they need to use/implement this validation method as part of the exercise.
issues.suggested_fix: Either remove the unused validatePerson(Person) method from the template so it matches the solution and problem statement, or add the same method (with intended behavior or documentation) to the solution and mention it in the problem statement. Preferably remove it from the template to avoid confusing students about whether validation is required unless the exercise explicitly asks them to implement such a validator.
